realms.name: Mount Olympus
realms.description: The highest peak, home of the twelve Olympian gods and the seat of divine kingship [S1][S2].

realms.name: The Sky (Ouranos)
realms.description: The vault of the sky, the domain of Ouranos and the element ruled by Zeus [S1].

realms.name: The Earth (Gaia)
realms.description: The inhabited world, the domain of Gaia and the realm of mortals and heroes [S1].

realms.name: The Sea (Poseidon)
realms.description: The great sea, ruled by Poseidon; the realm of sea-gods and monsters [S1].

realms.name: The Underworld (Hades)
realms.description: The realm of the dead, ruled by Hades and Persephone; its rivers (Styx, Acheron) and guardians (Cerberus) [S3][S5].

realms.name: Tartarus
realms.description: The abyss beneath the underworld, the prison of the defeated Titans and the place of the deepest punishment [S1].

structure_notes: A vertical cosmology: Sky/Olympus above, the Earth and Sea in the middle, the Underworld and the abyssal Tartarus below. The Olympians rule from Olympus; the dead are ruled from the Underworld; the defeated Titans are imprisoned in Tartarus [S1][S2][S3].
